title: Friends Quiz: Can You Remember These Obscure Details From Friends?
content:
About This Quiz
"Are you a die-hard ""Friends"" fan who can't get enough of Ross, Rachel, Monica, Chandler, Joey, and Phoebe? Test your knowledge with this ultimate Friends trivia quiz! From obscure details about Central Perk to Monica's apartment in New York City, see if you can remember all the little things that made this iconic sitcom so special.
Join in on the fun and challenge yourself to remember all the quirky moments and inside jokes from the tv show that aired from 1994 to 2004. With the amazing chemistry between the cast members both on and off-screen, ""Friends"" continues to be a beloved tv show that gains new fans year after year. So, gather your friends and see who can ace this Friends trivia quiz with flying colors!
Prove yourself a true Friends aficionado by acing this friends trivia quiz and showcasing your knowledge of the series. Whether you're a casual viewer or a dedicated superfan, this friends trivia questions will put your memory to the test and see just how well you remember the small details that made ""Friends"" such a timeless classic. So, grab your coffee cup, settle into your favorite spot on the couch, and get ready to relive all the unforgettable moments from the world of Friends!
"Ross sublets Ugly Naked Guy's apartment in season five.
Joey loves sandwiches and his favorite type is a meatball sub.
In the first episode, Rachel says she was more turned on by the gravy boat than she was by Barry.

Rachel wrote a letter to Ross that was 18 pages ... front and back!
Monica and Chandler named the twins after Monica's dad and the birth mother, Jack and Erica.
Ross was the last one to find out about Monica and Chandler.

The fake name that Joey uses is Ken Adams.
In season nine, episode eight, Rachel's sister Amy comes to visit and keeps calling her niece Ella.
To get away from Janice, Chandler lies and tells her he's moving to Yemen.

The grumpy man that lived below Monica was Mr. Heckles.
Monica told Phoebe that she lost her eyelash curler which is what caused Joey to figure out she was with Chandler all weekend.
Stuffed penguin of Joey was named Huggsy.

Monica tells Phoebe she wants her hair cut like Demi Moore.
Monica has 11 categories for her towels.
In the opening credits, the friends have red, blue and yellow umbrellas.

During the first season, the number in the apartment of Monica changed from 5 to 20.
Joey introduced Mike to Phoebe after he approached him to go on a double date as Phoebe's date. Joey had forgotten about the date and had to find a random "Mike."

The name of the couple that Monica and Chandler met on their honeymoon was Jenny and Greg.
Ross tells Phoebe and Rachel that 'Unagi' means "a total state of awareness."
At the end of the episode, Ross realizes he forgot Delaware and Chandler points out that he listed Nevada twice.

David and Phoebe break up because he moves to Minsk.
Joey's sisters are seven: Gina, Tina, Dina, Mary-Angela, Mary-Therese, Veronica and Cookie.
Ross and Monica's Nana used to steal Sweet'N Low's. Ross finds a huge stash of them in her closet.
